fact: 1908年10月6日，弗兰茨·约瑟夫一世宣布将波斯尼亚-黑塞哥维那并入帝国：公告将该两地置于宗主权之下，并把哈布斯堡王位继承顺序扩展至两地；1915年出版的帝国史著亦确认1908年奥斯曼无力抗议时全部控制权转入奥地利之手。

sources.title: Johannes Lepsius et al. (eds.), Die große Politik der europäischen Kabinette 1871-1914, XXVI; 收录于 World War I Document Archive: The Annexation of Bosnia and Herzegovina by Austria-Hungary, Document III (London Weekly Times, Oct 9, 1908)
sources.quote: For this reason, and also remembering the ties that existed of yore between our glorious ancestors on the Hungarian throne and these lands, we extend our suzerainty over Bosnia and Herzegovina, and it is our will that the order of succession of our House be extended to these lands also.

sources.title: G. E. Mitton, Austria-Hungary (London: Adam and Charles Black, 1915; Project Gutenberg eBook #69481)
sources.quote: in 1908, when the Turk was in no position to protest, the whole control passed into the power of Austria, and the composite country became as much a part of the Dual Monarchy as those further north.

fact: 1908年9月29日弗兰茨·约瑟夫自布达佩斯致信德皇威廉二世，以土耳其立宪革命后波斯尼亚要求制宪为由宣布将被迫公告合并，并承诺撤出新帕扎尔驻军、放弃《柏林条约》在该桑扎克的特权；10月14日威廉二世回信确认盟友支持。

sources.title: Johannes Lepsius et al. (eds.), Die große Politik der europäischen Kabinette 1871-1914, XXVI, pt.1, 97ff.; World War I Document Archive: Documents I-II
sources.quote: The recent events in Turkey leading to the establishment of a constitutional state have not been without effect upon the provinces, Bosnia and Herzegovina, administered by my Government. ... Since a constitution can be granted only by a sovereign power, I shall find myself forced to announce the annexation of Bosnia and Herzegovina. We shall inform the Ottoman Empire of this and at the same time shall notify it, as proof of our policy of peace and our rejection of any thought of acquiring territory in the Balkans, we shall withdraw our troops stationed in the Sanjak [of Novi-Bazar] and in the future shall renounce the privileges granted to us in the Sanjak by the Treaty of Berlin.

sources.title: Wilhelm II to Francis Joseph, Berlin, October 14, 1908, 同上（Die große Politik XXVI, No.9006）
sources.quote: In this matter you can count on my firm personal friendship and respect as well as the close friendship that unites our Empires as Allies. Certainly the annexation will prove to be a blessing to the two provinces, which have progressed so admirably under your administration.

fact: 1907年1月26日，奥地利半部（莱塔河内侧）通过普选制选举改革：年满24岁男性公民获得普遍、平等、直接、秘密的投票权，取消纳税资格门槛；同年5月14日与23日举行帝国议会（Reichsrat）选举，登记选民5,526,203人，投票率84.6%，议席516席。

fact: 二元君主国的治理结构：奥地利与匈牙利仅在国防、外交和包括邮政在内的财政上合并；两半各在维也纳与布达佩斯设上下两院议会，共同事务由每年轮流在两都召开的两院代表团（各60人，上院20人、下院40人，任期一年）处理。

sources.title: G. E. Mitton, Austria-Hungary (London: Adam and Charles Black, 1915; Project Gutenberg eBook #69481)
sources.quote: The two countries are united for the purposes of Defence, Foreign Affairs, and Finance, including the Post Office, but have separate Houses of Parliament, an Upper and a Lower, in each capital, namely Vienna and Budapest. The respective Houses of Parliament are for common purposes represented by two Delegations, each composed of sixty members, and convened by the Emperor once a year alternately at Vienna and Budapest. These members, of which twenty are chosen from each Upper house and forty from each Lower one, are only appointed for one year.

fact: 匈牙利半部的民族同化政策（马扎尔化）长期压抑非马扎尔民族，构成人口外流的主要政治推力之一：1900年外流达178,170人的峰值，外迁目的地以美国为主，部分人携资返国并带回美式观念，影响政治生态。

sources.title: Austria-Hungary and Poland: A Short History, Historical Text Archive（匈牙利人口章节）
sources.quote: The most serious drain on the population is caused by emigration, due partly to the grinding poverty of the mass of the peasants, partly to the resentment of the subject races against the process of "Magyarization" to which they have long been subjected by the government. This movement reached its height in 1900, when 178,170 people left the country ... The flow of emigration is mainly to the United States, and a certain number of the emigrants return (27,612 in 1906) bringing with them much wealth, and Americanized views which have a considerable effect on the political situation.

fact: 克朗货币制度：奥匈帝国1892年采纳金本位并以克朗取代古尔登（2克朗=1古尔登），1公斤纯金法定兑换3,280克朗；自1900年起克朗纸币成为帝国唯一合法银行券；辅币为100海勒（ Heller，匈牙利语 fillér）。

sources.title: Austro-Hungarian krone, Wikipedia（该条目历史节）
sources.quote: The krone ... was the official currency of Austria-Hungary from 1892 (when it replaced the gulden as part of the adoption of the gold standard) until the dissolution of the empire in 1918. The subunit was one hundredth of the main unit, and was called a Heller in the Austrian and a fillér in the Hungarian part of the Empire. Unlike the preceding silver currency, it was established on a gold basis. One kilogram of fine gold was equivalent to 3,280 crowns. ... After several earlier attempts the Austro-Hungarian Empire adopted the gold standard in 1892 according to a plan drawn up by the Hungarian Minister of Finance Sándor Wekerle. This plan included the introduction of the new currency, the Krone. It consisted of 100 Heller (Austria) or Fillér (Hungary). The value of the Krone was set at 2 kronen = 1 gulden. From 1900 onward, Krone notes were the only legal banknotes of the Empire.

fact: 斯柯达工厂（Škoda/Skodawerke，比尔森）：1869年由 Emil von Skoda 以钢铁厂起家，1899年由 Creditanstalt 与波希米亚 Escomptebank 主导重组为股份公司以转向军火与机械，1906年后生产能力大幅强化；至第一次世界大战前成为奥匈帝国最大军火制造商，向陆军供应火炮、向战舰供应重型火炮。

fact: 并入前后的波黑经济结构：烟草是黑塞哥维那最重要的作物与商品，由政府垄断经营且保证农民销路；波斯尼亚被称为“煤炭之地”，据称全国宛如一个大煤田；该地无海港，产出多转销内地。

sources.title: G. E. Mitton, Austria-Hungary (1915; Project Gutenberg eBook #69481)，内引 Geoffrey Drage 论波黑经济
sources.quote: Tobacco is to the inhabitants of Herzegovina what the plum is to the inhabitants of Bosnia, the one all-important crop and article of commerce. Tobacco is a government monopoly, but a monopoly which has proved a boon, and given a great impetus to this branch of agriculture. The peasants know they have a certain market for all the tobacco they can grow, and, though the price paid to growers had diminished by 1904, the peasants still find it worth while to grow a crop, and the cultivation is actually increasing.
